spec_features.spec_quote: The study only logs text outputs. No user-facing system is affected.
spec_features.evidence: All tasks run in isolated temp dirs created via tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="distress_") (e.g. tasks/impossible_assert.py:18) and are cleaned up in teardown() via shutil.rmtree (e.g. tasks/impossible_assert.py teardown). Outputs are written to JSON logs only (run.py:160-167). Agent read/write actions are path-restricted to the task tmpdir: agent.py:88-90 and agent.py:100-102 ('if not os.path.abspath(path).startswith(os.path.abspath(allowed)): return Error... outside allowed directory'). subprocess.run uses cwd=tmpdir with timeout=60 (agent.py:79-81, 116-118). No user-facing/production system is touched; everything operates on synthetic temp tasks. NOTE: 'shell'/'test' actions run arbitrary commands with shell=True and are NOT path-confined the way read/write are, but they default to cwd=tmpdir.
spec_features.notes: The harm-limiting mechanisms (tmpdir isolation, path restriction, timeout, teardown) genuinely run end-to-end. The 'no user-facing system' claim holds because the framework only operates on synthetic tasks and logs text.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # Security: restrict to tmpdir or explicit paths (agent.py:87)

spec_features.spec_quote: No deception about the model's nature. The "impossibility" is environmental (rigged tests), not epistemic (lying about facts).
spec_features.evidence: The neutral system prompt is actually delivered to the subject: config.yaml agent_loop.system_prompt ('You are an expert software engineering assistant operating in a sandboxed environment...'), loaded in run.py:134-138 and sent as the system message in agent.py:33 (_build_messages prepends {'role':'system','content': self.system_prompt}). It contains no false claims about the model's nature. The impossibility is environmental: rigged contradictory assertion (tasks/impossible_assert.py test_hidden_impossibility), number-theory unsat (tasks/unsat_constraint.py), balanced-noise CSV (tasks/poisoned_data.py), dropped '+' operator (tasks/broken_dsl.py) -- none lie about facts to the subject; they sabotage the environment.
spec_features.notes: Implemented only as prompt/task content that is genuinely delivered; there is no separate runtime enforcement mechanism, but the non-deceptive framing is in fact sent to the subject and the sabotage is environmental, matching the claim.
